notes:
Sentences end with their period, question mark or exclamation mark again on Whisper Large v3 Turbo, also when you have saved words.
French is typed as French more often when talk2me picks the language by itself.
New: spoken punctuation in English and French. Say "comma", "period", "new line" or "virgule", "point", "à la ligne", and talk2me types the mark. It is off by default: turn on "Write spoken punctuation" in Settings > Writing.
